dish_name_kh: ញាំមាន់ត្រយូងចេក
dish_name_en: Nhoam Moan Tr Young Cek (Chicken Banana Blossom Salad)

steps.text_kh: មាន់លាងឱ្យស្អាត ស្ងោរឱ្យឆ្អិន ជាមួយកោះថ្លើម
steps.text_en: Wash the chicken clean and boil until cooked with the gizzard and liver.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer other dish Nhoam Moan Tr Young Cek (Chicken Banana Blossom Salad), step 1: Wash the chicken clean and boil until cooked with the gizzard and liver.

steps.text_kh: ត្រយូងចេក ហាន់ស្តើងៗ យកទៅត្រាំទឹកដាក់ទឹកខ្មេះចូល ត្រាំកុំឱ្យខ្មៅ រួចស្រង់ដាក់ កញ្ច្រែងទុកសិន
steps.text_en: Slice the banana blossom thinly; soak in water with vinegar so it does not darken; drain and set aside.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer other dish Nhoam Moan Tr Young Cek (Chicken Banana Blossom Salad), step 2: Slice the banana blossom thinly; soak in water with vinegar so it does not darken; drain and set aside.

steps.text_kh: យកមាន់បេះតែសាច់ជាសរសៃល្អិតៗ កោះថ្លើមហាន់ដាក់ លាយជាមួយត្រយូងចេក បេះស្លឹកជីរត្រូវកុំដាក់ឱ្យច្រើនពេក ខ្ទឹមសហាន់ ចៀនឱ្យក្រហមដាក់លាយជាមួយគ្នាទាំងអស់
steps.text_en: Shred the chicken meat finely; chop gizzard and liver; mix with banana blossom and a little herb; add fried golden garlic.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer other dish Nhoam Moan Tr Young Cek (Chicken Banana Blossom Salad), step 3: Shred the chicken meat finely; chop gizzard and liver; mix with banana blossom and a little herb; add fried golden garlic.

steps.text_kh: យកទឹកត្រីលាយទឹកខ្មេះ ស្ករ ម្រេចបុក ម្សៅស៊ុប ភ្លក់មើលឱ្យល្មម យកទៅចាក់ចូលលាយឱ្យសព្វ ភ្លក់មើលឱ្យឆ្ងាញ់ជាការស្រេច
steps.text_en: Mix fish sauce with vinegar, sugar, pounded pepper, and soup powder; taste; pour over the salad and mix well.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer other dish Nhoam Moan Tr Young Cek (Chicken Banana Blossom Salad), step 4: Mix fish sauce with vinegar, sugar, pounded pepper, and soup powder; taste; pour over the salad and mix well.
